description: To answer a traveller, use find_trips first: it searches every trip on the site by place, name, number or link and returns dated prices. Search the FULL Sparkling Tracks coach-tour catalogue, not just the packages that have a dedicated page. list_packages and search_destinations cover the curated packages; this tool covers every tour on sale, including the hundreds that are sold on enquiry only, so "do you have anything in Portugal" gets a real answer instead of the curated slice. Each result gives the tour name, duration in days, the countries it visits, the Sparkling Tracks starting price in EUR (a "from" price for the cheapest departure of the year, land-only, lowest hotel tier), the next departure date or a dates-on-request flag, a one-click WhatsApp enquiry link with the tour name filled in, and the trip page URL when the tour has one (site_trip). Results are capped; when total_matches exceeds the cap, narrow the filters rather than asking for more. Every tour here is quote-based: a human confirms the final price after an enquiry, and no booking happens through this MCP.

country.description: Matched against the countries visited only (e.g. "portugal"), in English or in any of our languages. Use this instead of query when the user named a country rather than a theme.

currency.description: Currency for the price_localized fields. Conversion is approximate, EUR-based; the binding price at booking is always EUR. Default: EUR. A value outside the list is refused.

days_max.description: Only tours lasting at most this many days.

days_min.description: Only tours lasting at least this many days.

has_departures.description: true keeps only tours with a fixed departure still ahead on the published calendar; false keeps only the dates-on-request tours. Omit for both.

language.description: Output language for translatable fields (city names, country names, trip titles, descriptions). Default: en. zh is Simplified Chinese. A value outside the list is refused.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, 1 to 25. A number outside 1 to 25 is brought inside it, and the limit used is repeated under asked.

max_price_eur.description: Only tours whose starting price is at or below this EUR amount.

min_price_eur.description: Only tours whose starting price is at or above this EUR amount.

query.description: Text matched against the tour name, the countries it visits, and the cities on its route (e.g. "portugal", "fatima", "scandinavia"). Letter case and accents do not matter, and a city or country written in any of our languages is read as its English name.

name: search_all_tours
